title: File:Silliman University Anthropology Museum Display 01.jpg
description:
Located in Hibbard Hall in Dumaguete City, the Silliman University Anthropology Museum display preserves the rich cultural heritage of the Visayas and Negros regions. This ethnographic exhibit showcases traditional, hand-carved household utensils—such as the ungot (coconut shell drinking bowl) and duyas (wooden plates)—highlighting an era before modern plastics.
By feature-focusing on these everyday tools crafted from natural materials, the display provides a profound look into early Filipino indigenous lifestyles, tribal structures, and enduring ancestral craftsmanship.
